patches.reason: Japanese 十年以上 includes exactly ten years; លើសដប់ឆ្នាំ incorrectly excludes the boundary.

patches.reason: Matches canonical correction agr-par07-life-activity-consistency: refer to body categories without imposing three stages where paragraph2 names four.
